import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/protected/previous_release')
raw=p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else (p/'manifest.json').read_bytes()
print('path', p, 'bytes', len(raw), 'dir', p.is_dir())
obj=json.loads(raw)
print('type', type(obj).__name__)
if isinstance(obj, dict):
    print('keys', list(obj)[:40])
    for k,v in obj.items():
        print('VAL', k, type(v).__name__, (len(v) if hasattr(v,'__len__') and not isinstance(v,str) else ''))
